pages.text: A Hamming code with r parity bits checks a block of up to 2^r − 1 bits and corrects any one that flips. Two flips in one block get through: with a chance ε per bit, about (nε)²/2 of the blocks. Of every n bits, n − r carry data.
$(thing)Set$(): Block length, Parity bits.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Static on the line: the error rate varies by ±2%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): The code is too short for the block.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): More data per bit is faster.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Room in the code: 2^r − 1 − n$(br)Block failure: P ≈ (nε)²/2$(br)Code rate: k/n = (n − r)/n
